Author: Taurenkey, NightmareXIV, kawaii
Name: B.Work Artisan
Description:
自动制作
The all-in-one crafting plugin. Perfect for people with next to no knowledge about crafting rotations. No need for a library of different macros, the solvers will work dynamically to try and complete your crafts. Also provides convenient ways to craft lists of items or grind out a specific item repeatedly.
Changelog:
- List editor adjust quantities option now saved per list, and default behaviour has been added to the main settings list settings section.
- Adjusting quantities will now also update when clicking elsewhere in the window away from the input and not just on hitting enter.
